snippet.title: MoonLost - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
I'm proud to announce that MoonLost is finally available!
It's been 9 months of development full of joys and pains, but since mama didn't raise a quitter, here's my first video game in all its "raw splendor".
I hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed watching it take shape. Thanks for the support.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4054760/MoonLost/
Itch.io: https://dandelyon-gamedev.itch.io/project-wizard



Song:
Witch - Damiano Baldoni
